alerts.title: Delhi red alert for all 11 districts: waterlogging at Jhandewalan/Karol Bagh, rain also in Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad
alerts.summary: IMD issued a red alert for all 11 Delhi districts on Oct 12 (rain above 15 mm/hr, thunderstorm, ~60 kmph gusts) with an orange alert for parts of Haryana and UP. Waterlogging was reported on roads near Jhandewalan Temple (Karol Bagh), with similar weather in Noida, Gurugram and Ghaziabad. IMD expects isolated-to-scattered rain over Haryana, Chandigarh and Delhi through Oct 15, thunderstorms with 40-60 kmph winds on Oct 13-15, and rain in west UP till Oct 16.
alerts.impact: Expect LM attempt slippage and rider attendance dips in Delhi-NCR (Karol Bagh/central Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad) on Oct 12-15, during the Navratri demand build-up. Add a 1-day SLA buffer for low-lying/waterlogging-prone pincodes, re-sequence evening routes and avoid FM pickups from flooded lanes.

alerts.title: IMD: widespread rain over Himachal (Oct 14-15, 16-18), J&K and Uttarakhand (till Oct 18) adds to existing hill-road risk
alerts.summary: IMD's national bulletin (via ETV Bharat) forecasts rain over Himachal on Oct 12-13 with fairly widespread to widespread rain on Oct 14-15 and again Oct 16-18; J&K-Ladakh sees widespread rain on Oct 13 and 15; Uttarakhand rain continues until Oct 18. This follows record October rain in Jammu and active slides on NH-44 and the Adi Kailash route.
alerts.impact: Pre-position buffer stock at Jammu, Shimla, Mandi, Dehradun and Pithoragarh hubs; expect fresh landslide/shooting-stone closures on hill highways and add 24-48h SLA buffer for hill pincodes through Oct 18.

alerts.title: South India: heavy rain Oct 16-18 for Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry; 40-60 kmph thunderstorm winds Oct 12-15 in Tamil Nadu
alerts.summary: IMD forecasts rain over coastal Andhra, Rayalaseema, coastal Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry from Oct 12-18; Kerala sees widespread rain Oct 15-18 with isolated heavy rainfall over Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry on Oct 16-18. Strong surface winds are likely over coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema Oct 12-15 as the northeast monsoon nears.
alerts.impact: Plan weather buffers for Kerala, Chennai/TN coastal districts and Puducherry LM around Ayudha Puja/Dussehra (Oct 19-20), when fleet availability is already low; watch for waterlogging at low-lying Chennai/Kochi pincodes.

alerts.title: Jammu records heaviest October rainfall in 71 years; two dead, normal life disrupted across Jammu region
alerts.summary: Jammu recorded its highest October rainfall in 71 years over Oct 10-11, with two deaths reported and normal life disrupted, per Kashmir Observer, ThePrint and Greater Kashmir. Waterlogging, landslide and road-blockage risk remains across the Jammu division, adding to the existing NH-44 Ramban-Banihal shooting-stones restrictions.
alerts.impact: Treat Jammu city and the hill belts (Ramban, Doda, Udhampur, Reasi) as at-risk for LM delays; add a 24-48h SLA buffer at Jammu hub, hold FM pickups from flooded low-lying localities, and plan alternate/late-window routing on the Jammu-Srinagar NH-44 corridor until roads are cleared.

alerts.title: Delhi: mobile internet suspended within 4 km of Jantar Mantar; 45 of 303 metro stations shut during Oct 10 protest
alerts.summary: The Home Ministry ordered mobile internet suspended within a 4-km radius of the Janpath-Kartavya Path crossing from 10 pm Oct 9 to 10 pm Oct 10, after a 1.5-km, 12-hour suspension on Oct 2, plus a separate 500-m, 10-hour suspension reported around eight makeshift detention centres. During the Oct 10 protest against the Chief Election Commissioner the Solicitor General said 45 of 303 metro stations were closed. On Oct 11 the Supreme Court said 'Internet facilities should function unhindered' and the government said connectivity was restored; the matter is back before the bench on Oct 13.
alerts.impact: Central Delhi (4-km zone around Connaught Place/India Gate/Jantar Mantar) is exposed to repeat shutdowns and traffic/metro curbs: expect rider app/OTP/tracking failures, delivery attempt slippage and lower rider attendance there on protest days. Keep Delhi central-zone LM on offline-capable routing, add 1-day SLA buffer on protest dates, and watch the Oct 13 hearing for further orders.

alerts.title: J&K NH-44: single-lane crawl Ramban-Banihal and Dawal (Udhampur); night travel and tankers restricted amid shooting-stone risk
alerts.summary: J&K Traffic Police report very slow movement on NH-44 from 3 to 4 Oct due to single-lane traffic and NHAI widening/concrete work between Mager and Khooni Nallah, with 30-40 minute regulated halts at Dawal (Udhampur). Night travel is discouraged between Ramban and Banihal because of shooting stones and landslide risk, and oil/gas tankers are restricted to 0700-1900 hrs on the Digdol-Khooni Nallah axis. The Oct 5 plan allows LMVs and goods carriers both ways subject to fair weather; Kishtwar-Sinthan-Anantnag (NH-244), Mughal Road and Sonamarg-Gumri remain time-window restricted. Update (Oct 6 advisory): LMVs and passenger traffic allowed both ways on NH-44 subject to fair weather; oil/gas tankers still restricted 0700-1900 hrs on the Digdol-Khooni Nallah widening stretch, and loaded tankers may move from Chenani only 1700-0500 hrs. Srinagar-Sonamarg-Gumri road has a 1 PM cutoff (Kargil-bound traffic only 1200-1700), Mughal Road (Poonch-Shopian) is open 0700-1800 only, and Kishtwar-Sinthan-Anantnag allows light vehicles 0900-1600 with approval.
alerts.impact: Plan Jammu-Srinagar line-haul for daytime only and add 6-12h buffer for Kashmir-bound FM/LM via Ramban and Banihal; avoid night dispatch. Re-check TCU Ramban status before dispatch, and keep Kashmir hubs stocked in case rain closes the highway.

alerts.title: Longleng landslide near Yongshei blocks ~80% of Dikhou River channel; Sivasagar (Assam) downstream villages on alert
alerts.summary: Sivasagar district administration issued a cautionary advisory after a major landslide between Yaongyimsen (Mokokchung) and Yongshei (Longleng) in Nagaland blocked about 80% of the Dikhou River channel, per the Longleng Deputy Commissioner's Sep 30 message and the Yongshei village chairman. No abnormal flow or sudden drop in water level has been seen downstream so far and the Dikhou level at Bihubar is stable; ground verification was scheduled for Oct 1.
alerts.impact: Early-warning signal only: if the blockage breaches, riverside villages along the Dikhou in Sivasagar district (Assam) and low-lying Longleng/Mokokchung belts could see sudden flash flooding. Keep a short watch on Sivasagar and Nagaland hill-road LM, avoid parking FM pickups near the Dikhou banks, and re-check after the ground verification report.

alerts.title: Balasore's Bhograi: 30+ villages in 10 panchayats still waterlogged, roads under ~3 ft water at Kachuadi, Kulida, Nachinda, Putina
alerts.summary: Odisha TV reports over 30 villages across 10 gram panchayats in Bhograi block (and parts of Basudevpur in Bhadrak) remain waterlogged even as rivers recede. Roads in Kachuadi, Siaruib, Kulida, Kusuda, Gabagaon, Nachinda and Putina panchayats are under about three feet of water, homes are flooded waist-deep, and residents are living in cyclone shelters. About 34 people from Makarapada were stranded for nearly four days before fire-service rescue. Update (Oct 13): IMD forecasts further rain over Odisha from Oct 12 to 18, which may slow drainage.
alerts.impact: Treat Bhograi block panchayats (Kachuadi, Kulida, Kusuda, Gabagaon, Nachinda, Putina) and adjoining Basudevpur pincodes as non-serviceable for LM; hold FM pickups from sellers there and expect RTO/undelivered build-up at the Balasore hub until drainage clears.

alerts.title: Commercial LPG cylinder up Rs 62.50 from Oct 1 (some reports Rs 71.50 by city); ATF up; domestic LPG unchanged
alerts.summary: Oil marketing companies raised the price of the 19-kg commercial LPG cylinder from 1 October 2026 by about Rs 62.50 (reports cite up to Rs 71.50 depending on city), and aviation turbine fuel by about Rs 16 per litre, ahead of the festive season. Domestic LPG prices were left unchanged. Exact city-wise rates vary by outlet.
alerts.impact: Expect cost pressure for sort-centre canteens, hub operations and food-linked sellers; watch for fuel-surcharge asks from Delhivery, Shadowfax and Xpressbees as diesel/gas costs flow into pre-Diwali rate negotiations. No direct LM/FM stoppage.

alerts.title: UFBU 3-day bank strike (Sep 28-30) over; indefinite strike threatened from Oct 26
alerts.summary: The UFBU three-day public-sector bank strike ended on 30 September. Unions have announced an indefinite strike from October 26 if the five-day banking week demand remains unresolved.
alerts.impact: Clear any COD cash-deposit backlog accumulated at PSU branches during Sep 28-30 with Delhivery, Shadowfax and Xpressbees; keep digital/ATM/BC deposit routes ready ahead of a possible Oct 26 stoppage just before the Diwali peak.

alerts.title: Fresh landslide near Jangalikh village (Rohru, Chhohara block) blocks pedestrian route on Sundru Khad
alerts.summary: A fresh landslide near Jangalikh village in Chhohara development block of Rohru sub-division, Shimla district, sent debris into the Sundru Khad on 28 September, blocking the pedestrian route to the village. The Rohru SDM confirmed that despite fears of a temporary blockage forming a lake in the khad, water flow has returned to normal and no lake formed; the administration is continuing to monitor the site. PTI (via DD India) adds that stones had been rolling down the hill since Sunday, some nearby villages were cut off and traffic was disrupted; the administration has appealed to people to avoid the Pabbar river and surrounding khads, particularly in the Janglikh area. Update: Himachal CM Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu visited Rohru villages and directed that the Janglik road be reopened within ten days, with Rs 6 crore sanctioned for bridge construction.
alerts.impact: Treat the Jangalikh (Chhohara block, Rohru) pedestrian/foot route as non-serviceable for FM pickups until debris is cleared; vehicular LM in the wider Rohru belt is unaffected for now since the khad did not dam up, but keep a short watch for renewed slippage given the string of active slides elsewhere in Shimla and Mandi districts this week.

alerts.title: Bihar: Gandak hits record 91.25 m at Bagaha; embankments breached at Khairatwa, Phuliyakhad, Areraj, Paroo, Maker
alerts.summary: Heavy rain in Nepal pushed the Gandak to a record 91.25 m at Bagaha (West Champaran), beating the 2024 mark of 90.90 m, with 5.43 lakh cusecs discharged at Valmikinagar barrage. Breaches were reported at Khairatwa (Bagaha-1) and Phuliyakhad (Bairia), a ring embankment in Areraj block (East Champaran), Paroo block (Muzaffarpur) and Maker block (Saran); floodwater has entered villages and homes across West/East Champaran and five panchayats in Gopalganj. Officials repaired 169 seepage/piping points; in Khagaria, boats and relief camps were set up as the Kosi and Bagmati also press other districts. Update (Oct 5-6): reports say the flood crisis in Bihar is deepening as Gandak embankment breaches persist across multiple districts, and the Chief Minister reviewed the flood situation on Oct 6. Update (Oct 11): Al Jazeera reports a landslide-triggered flash flood in Nepal's Budhi Gandaki valley with five missing; the Budhi Gandaki feeds the Gandak (Narayani) system, so keep watching Nepal discharge at Valmikinagar.
alerts.impact: Flag Bagaha, Bairia (West Champaran), Areraj (East Champaran), Paroo (Muzaffarpur), Maker (Saran) and the Gopalganj flood panchayats as non-serviceable for LM; hold FM pickups there and add 48-72h SLA buffer at Bettiah, Motihari, Gopalganj and Muzaffarpur hubs. Expect further breach/overtopping risk while Nepal discharge stays high.

alerts.title: Landslide at Mangti nullah blocks Adi Kailash route; 350+ pilgrims halted at Dharchula (Pithoragarh)
alerts.summary: A landslide at Mangti nullah on the Adi Kailash route in Pithoragarh district blocked the road, and more than 350 pilgrims and travellers were stopped at Dharchula, per reports dated 2 October.
alerts.impact: Treat the Dharchula-Gunji-Kuti border belt as non-serviceable for LM/FM until the road is cleared; hold pickups from sellers beyond Dharchula and add a 24-48h SLA buffer for Pithoragarh hub inbound.
